rows.en: Touya: "...So that's ≪Ze=Ode≫..."
Ymir: "Are you all right? You look pale."
Touya: "Y-Yeah. I'm a little tired... But I'm fine.
Still, how did Rayblade move
when it had been sealed away?"
Ymir: "I don't know... But perhaps the sound of the Resonance Crystal
being audible only to you, Touya, has something to do with it...
In any case, it's a good thing Rayblade moved."
Ivel: "..."
Celica: "But the field around ≪Ze=Ode≫
was so powerful...
It's frightening to think there are five more like that."
Touya: "Five? If that many came at us at once,
we wouldn't stand a chance..."
Ai: "Hey, who's this Lenis that Pilot was shouting about?
It sounded like he was talking about Touya..."
Emy: "You don't even know that?
Lenis Enroad. A hundred and nine years ago, ≪Ze=Ode≫
was studied by a group of Alchemists, and he was one of them.
And before the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫, he worked with another
Alchemist, Wenimas Latia,
to try to stop Dr. Debish's plan.
...Or so the records say."
Touya: "I've heard that."
Ai: "Huh? How do you know?"
Ymir: "Didn't someone explain it to you on the way here?"
Ai: "...Come to think of it, I sort of remember hearing something like that..."
Ymir: "As for the machines known as ≪Ze=Ode≫,
there are apparently six in all. Rayode, which we just saw,
Eleana, Gaiozon, Parthenos and Goderius
are the only five confirmed to exist.
We don't know much about them.
About all else we know are the names Bafred Debish,
Wenimas Latia and Lenis Enroad,
the three researchers.
Apparently they were also Pilots..."
Touya: "...Then the guy piloting that machine
is someone from over a hundred years ago?"
Ymir: "Or someone who believes he is..."
Ai: "He sounded a little too emotional for that.
And he didn't seem like a ≪Ze=Ode≫ fanatic, either."
Ivel: "...I'm certain that person is from a hundred and nine years ago,
one of the researchers."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel... Do you mean a dead person
has come back to life?"
Ivel: "'Come back to life' isn't the right expression.
They have 'come' to this era."
Touya: "A time slip... So that's why he called himself
a ghost from a hundred years ago..."
Ivel: "I don't know why it should be our era.
But the wheels we call fate have begun to turn.
Ever since that day, twenty-nine years ago..."
Ymir: "Twenty-nine years ago?"
Ivel: "Oh, no. It's nothing.
More importantly, the problem is that the Spirit Mechs' attacks
barely affected that machine."
Emy: "We're hurrying to analyze the data.
If we can find a way to interfere with that field,
the Spirit Mechs' output should be enough to fight it."
Ivel: "Yes. I'll leave that to you."
Emy: "Yes!"
Ivel: "...Now, things are going to get busy.
With Rayblade moving again..."
Lodis: "Yes. For a start, the Kingdom of Agarthia's Council
isn't going to stay quiet..."
Touya: "...Well? Does it look like Rayblade will move?"
Celica: "Hmm... Its systems seem to be alive,
but I can't get a peep out of it."
Touya: "Is it broken?"
Celica: "I don't think so...
Well, I'll try a few things."
Yamato: "You seem to be enjoying yourself."
Celica: "Huh? Do I? Heh heh heh...
Well, the last time I tried to examine it,
it had already been sealed away.
Any normal girl would be excited, wouldn't she?"
Touya: "...Isn't that just you?"
Celica: "Anyway, the maintenance crew who came with us from York
are here, too. We'll get it fixed up perfectly."
Yamato: "Then are Ymir and the others investigating the field?"
Celica: "Yes. Luckily, we managed to extract Rayblade's combat records.
They're comparing them with Clovis and the others' data
and analyzing them now."
Touya: "Is there anything I can do to help?"
Celica: "Hmm... I appreciate the offer,
but leave this to the experts! Once we have some idea of what to do,
we might ask you to help, Touya."
Touya: "All right. I'll leave it to you until then.
Just tell me whenever you need a hand."
Celica: "Of course. When the time comes,
I won't hesitate to work you hard."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Oh... Isn't that Xiujian?"
Touya: "Yeah, looks like it... What's he doing?"
Yamato: "It looks like he's servicing that Spirit Mech..."
Mechanic F: "You'd better not talk to him."
Touya: "Huh? Why not?"
Mechanic F: "That machine's called Ahti.
Apparently his girlfriend used to pilot it.
Then she went missing, and ever since, he won't let anyone
touch it. That's what I hear.
I didn't know and tried to check it the other day,
and I nearly got 'taken out.'"
Talk to him
Leave him alone
Xiujian: "...What is it?"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, I don't really have any business with you..."
Xiujian: "...Then I'd rather you didn't get in my way."
Touya: "...Hey, is it true your girlfriend
used to pilot that machine?"
Xiujian: "...That mechanic...
Going on about things that are none of their business..."
Touya: "Why won't you let anyone touch it?
Don't you trust them?"
Xiujian: "Heh..."
Touya: "What? What's so funny?"
Xiujian: "Your potential is impressive,
but you still have a long way to go as a Spirit Mech Pilot."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Xiujian: "I'm not saying you have to do all the maintenance yourself,
but you should at least tune your own machine.
In the end, you're the only one who can protect yourself."
Touya: "...It's true I've been leaving it all to everyone else..."
Xiujian: "Besides, I want to keep Ahti ready to move
at any time. So when she... when Melissa comes back,
it'll be ready for her."
Touya: "Melissa... So that's your girlfriend's name...
But how did she go missing...?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "Is something wrong?"
Xiujian: "I seem to have said a little too much."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Touya... We shouldn't ask any more..."
Touya: "...Yeah... Sorry about that. See you."
Aurelie: "Oh, you're..."
Touya: "Hm? Oh, you're..."
Aurelie: "Aurelie Pandavoine.
I watched your battle.
You seem promising, but you've still got a long way to go."
Touya: "Oh, you've got plenty to say."
Aurelie: "Are you angry?"
Touya: "Well, it doesn't exactly feel good."
Aurelie: "Because I'm a woman?"
Touya: "Huh? That has nothing to do with it."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "I don't know what you're trying to say,
but maybe you're so sensitive about it because you keep worrying
about who's a man and who's a woman."
Aurelie: "...You've got some nerve..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya..."
Aurelie: "!!"
Yamato: "...Oh."
Touya: "Oh, great. Didn't I tell you not to talk so much
in front of people? It makes things complicated..."
Aurelie: "..."
Yamato: "H-Hey... She's staring right at me..."
Touya: "Was it that much of a shock?
...Hellooo..."
Aurelie: "...S-So cute..."
Yamato: "...Huh? What?"
Aurelie: "So cuuute!♥"
Aurelie: "H-Hey, hey! What's this little one's name?"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, her name's Yamato..."
Aurelie: "Yamato... What a lovely name!
Hello, Yamato!♥"
Touya: "She's like a completely different person..."
Yamato: "N-Nice to meet you, Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Aah, she's adorable!
Hey, would you give Yamato to me?"
Touya: "What?"
Aurelie: "I said, I want you
to give her to me!"
Touya: "Don't be stupid! Yamato's my family.
What idiot would give their family away to someone else?!"
Aurelie: "...Family?"
Yamato: "After losing his parents, Touya found me
and raised me. We've been together ever since."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "What is it now?"
Aurelie: "...*sniff*..."
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Aurelie: "So that's how it is... *sniff*... You've...
had such a hard life..."
Aurelie: "All right! From today on,
you can think of me as your big sister and lean on me!"
Touya: "Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?"
Aurelie: "And then Yamato and I will be sisters, too!"
Touya: "...So that's what you were after."
Ai: "Oh, there you are! Where have you been wandering off to?!
Ymir's looking for you."
Touya: "Why?"
Ai: "She said something about where you're staying
tonight."
Touya: "I can just stay aboard the Liebhofen, can't I?"
Ai: "Don't ask me! She just asked me
to come get you. Come on, hurry up!"
Touya: "H-Hey! Don't pull my hand!
Walk a little slower!"
Ai: "Huh? You want to hold my hand
and take your time enjoying this moment with me?
Well, if that's what you want, just say..."
Touya: "Right, let's go!"
Ai: "Hey! What's with that attitude?!
You're, like, totally B.A.!"
Touya: "Stop using those code words. I don't even know if anyone still says that.
And don't talk in that tone.
It makes me want to kill you.
What the hell does 'B.A.' mean, anyway?"
Ai: "You don't even know that?
'B.A.' is short for Bad Attitude."
Touya: "You know some oddly difficult words.
If only you'd put that enthusiasm
into something else..."
Ai: "Oh, shut up. Keep saying things like that,
and the National High School Girls' Union will send a hitman after you!"
Touya: "Is there really such a thing?"
Ai: "Who knows?"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "All right, all right. Let's go."
Aurelie: "...She hasn't changed either..."
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Ai: "I brought him!"
Ymir: "Thank you."
Touya: "What did you want?"
Ymir: "Well... It's about where you and Yamato
will be staying. The Liebhofen is in the workshop
for maintenance right now,
and the Holy Land's lodgings are full."
Ai: "There are more mechanics than before, after all.
They usually all sleep on the floor of the hangar,
so at a time like this, we ought to let them sleep properly..."
Ymir: "So I was thinking you could stay at my sister-in-law's house.
Would you mind?"
Touya: "I don't mind, but..."
Ymir: "What a relief..."
Ai: "Hm? You're acting a little strange..."
Ymir: "Huh? A-Am I?"
Ai: "...Oh! Ymir, didn't you say you lived with your brother
and his wife?
...Then that means... It's your house, isn't it?!"
Ymir: "Huh? W-Well, yes, I suppose it is..."
Ai: "Oh, no! No, no!
'At seven, boys and girls no longer sit together'!
Don't you know that saying?!"
Yamato: "Ai, you know a lot about the strangest things..."
Ymir: "I think you've misunderstood...
I'm analyzing ≪Ze=Ode≫'s special field,
so I won't be coming home tonight. That's why..."
Ai: "Then why were you fidgeting like that?"
Ymir: "Because I was worried he might say no..."
Yamato: "Ohh, I see... Ai, you're..."
Ai: "Yamaaato... If you say another word,
I'll boil you..."
Yamato: "Uh... I don't think I'd like that..."
Ymir: "I'll show you the way, then.
Ai, would you like to come, too?"
Ai: "...No. I'm going back to my room.
See you!"
Touya: "...What's with her?"
Ai: "Hmm. Well, whatever."
Ymir: "Ai, would you like to come, too?"
Ai: "Hmm... No, thanks. There's no need to rush things."
Ymir: "???"
Ai: "Well, anyway, I'll be off."
Touya: "...What's with her?"
?????: "Welcome. You must be Touya.
It's nice to meet you. I'm Forzen Jin Clasio's wife,
Paldia.
Thank you for always looking after Ymir."
Touya: "Huh? Oh, no... I haven't really...
Hm? Forzen... You mean that Forzen...?"
Paldia: "Has my husband been rude again?
I gave him a talking-to after what happened with Ai...
I'm sorry."
Touya: "Oh, no, it's nothing... Then Ymir
is that Forzen's sister?"
Ymir: "Yes. Hadn't I told you?"
Touya: "I see... Siblings can be that different, huh...?"
Paldia: "Hee hee. You've found yourself a nice young man, Ymir."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Paldia: "Come on, we can carry on talking over dinner.
Today's a day to remember,
so I went a little all out."
Ymir: "Um, I'll be going, then..."
Paldia: "Huh? Aren't you staying to eat?"
Ymir: "I'm sorry.
There's still a little work I have to do."
Paldia: "What? How can one of today's guests of honor
not be here? Your boyfriend will be lonely!"
Touya: "Boyfriend...? Who are you talking about?"
Paldia: "My, you're quite the joker."
Ymir: "W-Wait, Paldia!
He and I, um... It's not that kind of relationship..."
Paldia: "Oh, there's no need to be so embarrassed.
You two make a lovely couple."
Touya: "What?! Y-You mean me?!"
Paldia: "Oh... Was I really wrong?
It's the first time Ymir has brought a man home,
so I just assumed..."
Ymir: "Paldia!"
Paldia: "My, my. You don't seem entirely against the idea.
Well, it's not too late. Touya,
if you don't already have someone, what do you think of her?"
Ymir: "Please don't go deciding things for us!
Touya's uncomfortable, too, isn't he? ...I'm sorry."
Touya: "Huh? Oh, I don't mind..."
Paldia: "Hmm... Ymir.
Take some advice from someone with more experience in love.
You should stop talking to him like that all the time.
Formal speech shows respect,
but it also puts distance between you.
Especially when you're talking to a man."
Ymir: "O-Oh..."
Paldia: "...So, starting today, when you speak to Touya,
no more of that formal tone. All right?"
Ymir: "You can't just decide that for me..."
Touya: "I'd prefer it that way."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Paldia: "There, it's settled."
Ymir: "...Do you really not mind?"
Touya: "I don't talk formally to you, do I?
If you don't mind, Ymir, I'd rather you didn't, either."
Ymir: "V-Very well. I'll do that."
Touya: "And I'd rather you dropped the honorific
when you call me."
Ymir: "Y-Yes, I understand... Oh,
no, I mean... got it."
Paldia: "All right, all right. Now that that's happily settled,
let's eat..."
Ymir: "Oh, but I really... Besides,
I need to get back to the laboratory soon."
Paldia: "You do...?
That's a shame, but I can't make you stay."
Ymir: "I'm sorry.
I'll leave the rest to you, then.
Make yourself at home, Touya."
Paldia: "Please look after her for me.
Oh, I don't mean anything odd by that.
Ymir has a tendency to work just a little
too hard... You see."
????: "Huh? Mom, where's Ymir?"
Paldia: "Oh, Melvi.
Well, unfortunately, Ymir
still has work to do, so she can't stay today."
Melvi: "No... I was looking forward to it so much..."
Touya: "Um... Who's this?"
Paldia: "Oh, let me introduce you.
This is my daughter, Melvi."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "Good evening."
Melvi: "G-Good evening..."
Paldia: "My, my. You're being awfully shy.
I wonder what's gotten into you."
Melvi: "Oh, Mom, you're mean!"
Paldia: "Hee hee hee...
Come on, you must be hungry. Let's eat.
Melvi, would you help?"
Melvi: "Okaaay!"
Touya: "...Phew... That was delicious. Thank you for dinner."
Paldia: "You're welcome. You certainly eat like a boy.
You enjoy it so much, it makes cooking worthwhile."
Melvi: "..."
Yamato: "Someone's looking at me awfully intently..."
Touya: "...Would you like to hold her?"
Melvi: "C-Can I...?"
Touya: "Here you go."
Melvi: "She's so cute!"
Paldia: "Ymir told me about it,
but she really can talk properly, can't she?"
Touya: "Yeah. It surprised me at first,
but now I've come to think it's rather nice."
Melvi: "Yamato, up, up you go!"
Yamato: "Ha, ha ha ha..."
Melvi: "If only Ymir were here, too,
it would've been even more fun..."
Touya: "Melvi, do you like Ymir?"
Melvi: "Yeah! She's so pretty
and kind! When I grow up,
I want to be just like her!"
Touya: "I'm sure you can, Melvi."
Melvi: "But... My hair isn't as pretty
as hers..."
Touya: "You think so? Just like your mom,
you have lovely blond hair."
Melvi: "But I wish I had silver hair like hers...
Dad and Dad's dad all have blond hair,
and she's the only one who's special. I want to be..."
Paldia: "Melvi. It's about time you went to bed.
Touya's tired, too."
Melvi: "Aww, can't I stay up a little longer?"
Paldia: "Nooo. Come on, go change into your pajamas."
Melvi: "Okaaay. Hey, Touya.
Can I sleep with Yamato?"
Touya: "Huh? W-Well, I don't mind... Yamato, what about you?"
Yamato: "I don't mind."
Melvi: "Yay! Good night, then!"
Paldia: "Oh, wait a moment...
I'll help you."
Melvi: "It's all right. I can do it on my own now."
Paldia: "What are you saying? Are you trying to take away
one of your mother's little pleasures?
Oh, Touya, please wait here a moment."
Touya: "All right."
Touya: "...Family, huh..."
